status: predeclared train-only ROI fit and internal source-group holdout

input_policy.admitted_rows: manifest records with split=train and kind positive or background_only and trainable_single_box=true
input_policy.excluded_rows: never open annotation or image payloads for kind=excluded
input_policy.hash_split: union source groups that share an admitted image SHA-256; hold out complete linked components; fail any train-fit overlap

localization_rule.fit_rows: unique admitted positive image hashes from all trainable source groups outside the fixed 3-group internal holdout
localization_rule.glyph_geometry: exact target_crop_xyxy from curation annotation, whose glyph-mask bounds were validated during curation
localization_rule.roi: axis-aligned min left/top and max right/bottom of target boxes relative to mapped seed center, expanded by fixed 2 crop pixels on every side

numeric_v5.crop: production OcrCropBatcher 128x32, horizontal padding 12, vertical padding 1, content ratio 0.25, preserve aspect and pad

official_ppocr.crop: production OcrCropBatcher 320x48, horizontal padding 8, vertical padding 2, preserve aspect and pad

limitations: The fit and internal holdout are procedural train sources, not real graphs.
One envelope ROI may include excess context; the rule does not localize multiple labels within a crop.
These diagnostics do not establish product acceptance or authorize production activation.
